title: BBQ Masala Vego Burgers
subtitle: with Mango Chutney and Spinach
description: Whether you’re full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they’re packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they’re totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the barbecue to high (see Don't have a barbie?). Thinly slice the onion. Cut the bread rolls in half. Combine half the masala seasoning and 2 tsp olive oil in a shallow bowl. Add the plant-based patties and turn to coat.

Cook onion and patties: Heat 2 tsp olive oil on the barbecue flatplate. Cook the onion, tossing occasionally, for 4-5 mins until softened and charred. Remove from the flatplate. Meanwhile, cook the patties on the barbecue grill for 4-5 mins each side until browned. Remove from the grill.
Toast bread rolls: While the patties are cooking, put the bread rolls, cut-side down, on the barbecue and cook for 4-5 mins until toasted. Remove from the barbecue.
Dress spinach: Combine 1 tsp olive oil and ½ tsp red wine vinegar in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the spinach and toss to coat.

Serve up: Combine the remaining masala seasoning and 2 tbs mayonnaise in a bowl. Spread the roll bases with the mayo mixture. Layer with the spinach, patties, onion and mango chutney, then sandwich with the tops. Serve with any remaining spinach and enjoy!
Don't have a barbie?: No worries, you can use a chargrill pan or frypan – just adjust the cook times!
